root_idea.summary: The clearest attested semantic center is the ear or spike borne by grain, with a related verb describing grain as putting forth such ears.
root_idea.development: The supplied evidence supports an association between سُنْبُلٌ and سَنْبَلَ الزرع. Separate botanical, astronomical, perfumery, garment, and garment-description uses are preserved independently rather than being derived from an asserted root principle.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Used as the normalized public citation form for the Quranic grain-ear noun.
The plural سُنْبُلَات is represented under the normalized grain-ear headword سُنْبُلٌ.
The unit noun سُنْبُلَة and its pluralized Quranic forms belong to the same grain-ear lexical entry.

senses.definition: An ear or spike of grain, especially an ear of corn.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the ear or spike of a grain plant and for ears collectively. The unit form is سُنْبُلَةٌ, with plurals سَنَابِلُ and سُنْبُلَاتٌ; the supplied Quranic occurrences include unit, plural, and possessive forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a crop or seed-produce: to put forth ears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive verbal use describing the emergence of ears from grain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drag a shirt or other garment behind or before oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A garment-related verbal construction, distinct from the crop-related sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Virgo, the sixth sign of the zodiac; also a star in Virgo.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An astronomical designation, distinct from the grain-ear noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sweet-scented plant or perfume, especially spikenard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in botanical, perfumery, and materia-medica contexts; regional varieties are also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of tree belonging to the class called عِضَاه.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical use of the vocalized form سَنْبَلَةٌ, distinct from the Quranic grain-ear noun سُنْبُلَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Describing a shirt that is ample in length or reaches toward the ground; alternatively, a designation relating to a town or district in the Greek Empire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression قَمِيصٌ سُنْبُلَانِيٌّ; the source records both a garment-description and a geographic explanation.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Crop putting forth ears is represented as a Classical verbal meaning.
The garment-dragging verbal use is represented separately.
Both the grain-ear meaning and the zodiac designation are represented.
The sweet-scented plant or perfume meaning is represented.
The distinct botanical use of سَنْبَلَةٌ is represented.
The سُنْبُلَانِيّ garment description and its alternative geographic explanation are represented.

cautions: No matched Maqāyīs or Mufradāt material was supplied; the root-level orientation is therefore limited to the supplied Lane evidence.
The Quranic noun forms are normalized under سُنْبُلٌ, while سُنْبُلَةٌ, سَنَابِلُ, and سُنْبُلَاتٌ are retained as its unit and plural forms.
